tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from 10x Genomics instruments, consumables, and biological cloud software ($150.67M in Q3 2026, beating Street consensus $147.85M by +1.91%).
tooltip_definitions.Consumables Revenue: Recurring high-margin reagent kits and microfluidic chips across Chromium Single Cell and Visium/Xenium spatial biology ($134.33M in Q3 2026, up +5.0% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Instruments Revenue: Capital hardware placements of Chromium, Visium, Xenium, and newly launched Atera platforms ($6.86M in Q3 2026, down -42.8% YoY due to budget freezes).
tooltip_definitions.Services & Other Revenue: Contract sequencing services, biopharma validation pilots, software subscriptions, and non-recurring patent litigation licensing royalties ($9.48M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Gross Profit: Gross profit of $112.93M in Q3 2026 delivering a 74.95% gross margin, expanding 763 bps YoY from 67.32% due to lower inventory write-downs and favorable mix.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Operating Income: Operating loss of -$16.06M in Q3 2026 ($112.93M Gross Profit - $128.98M OpEx), improving by over 50% from -$32.24M in Q3 2025 on overhead discipline.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: GAAP diluted net loss per share of -$0.15 in Q3 2026 based on 130.8M weighted average common shares outstanding.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Operating cash flow of $25.25M generated in Q3 2026, rising +48.8% sequentially from $16.97M in Q2 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Property, plant, and laboratory equipment additions of $1.60M in Q3 2026, reflecting lean facility investments.
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow ($25.25M) minus CapEx ($1.60M), generating positive reported free cash flow of $23.65M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity incentives and stock compensation of $23.10M in Q3 2026 ($8.94M R&D, $12.00M SG&A, $2.16M COGS).
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Economic cash generation deducting CapEx ($1.60M) and non-cash SBC ($23.10M) from OCF ($25.25M), yielding positive True FCF of $0.55M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Atera Commercial Shipments: 10x Genomics' revolutionary next-generation spatial biology platform, combining in situ transcriptomics and protein detection, with global shipments commenced in Q3.
tooltip_definitions.Sentira Cloud Platform: Newly introduced cloud analysis platform powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing for spatial imaging and Anthropic's Claude for agentic AI analysis of single-cell datasets.
tooltip_definitions.FY 2026 Revenue Guidance Raise: Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised to $625M - $635M ($630.0M midpoint), up from prior guidance of $610M - $630M ($620.0M midpoint).
tooltip_definitions.Implied Q4 2026 Revenue: Raised FY guidance implies Q4 2026 revenue of approximately $172.5M - $182.5M (~$175.0M midpoint), representing sequential acceleration.
tooltip_definitions.Liquid Treasury Reserves: Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaling $575.68M as of September 30, 2026, with zero long-term funded debt.
tooltip_definitions.After-Hours Reaction: TXG shares declined -9.73% to $52.41 after hours as an EPS miss (-$0.15 vs -$0.02 Street) and instrument revenue weakness (-42.8% YoY) triggered short-term multiple compression.
tooltip_definitions.Academic Budgetary Headwinds: Constrained NIH funding and institutional grant delays in the U.S. and Europe lengthening instrument procurement decision cycles.
tooltip_definitions.China Biomedical Demand: Asia-Pacific revenues stabilized at $25.97M ($15.22M China), showing resilient consumables demand despite macroeconomic cross-currents.
